# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 23 02:08" is shown in the center of the title bar.
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible to the right of the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Three standard window control buttons are present on the far right: Minimize (dash), Maximize/Restore (square), and Close (X).
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the far left of the title bar, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Icons and Functionality**:
  - **File Explorer Icon**: A folder icon, currently active.
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon.
  - **Source Control Icon**: A branching icon.
  - **Debug Icon**: A bug icon.
  - **Extensions Icon**: A square grid icon.
  - **Terminal Icon**: A terminal window icon.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon.
  - **User Profile Icon**: A person silhouette icon.
  - **Outline and Timeline Icons**: Located below the gear icon, with expandable sections labeled "OUTLINE" and "TIMELINE".

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top.
- **Project Folder**: A folder named "PROJECT" is expanded, showing its contents:
  - `README.md`
  - `test_todo.py`
  - `todo.py`
- **Project Structure**: The folder structure is displayed with icons indicating file types.

## Main Editor Area

- **Active Tab**: The "Welcome" tab is active, indicated by a blue icon and the word "Welcome" with a close (X) button.
- **Welcome Page Content**:
  - **Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font.
  - **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved" in smaller font.
  - **Start Section**:
    - "New File..."
    - "Open File..."
    - "Open Folder..."
    - "Connect to..."
  - **Recent Section**:
    - "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
  - **Walkthroughs Section**:
    - "Get Started with VS Code" with a star icon and description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding".
    - "Learn the Fundamentals" with a lightbulb icon.

## Terminal Panel

- **Tab Bar**: Contains tabs for "PROBLEMS", "OUTPUT", "DEBUG CONSOLE", "TERMINAL", and "PORTS". The "TERMINAL" tab is active.
- **Terminal Content**:
  - **Prompt**: `user@user-virtual-machine:~/project$`
  - **Command**: `d /home/us` (incomplete command).
  - **Terminal Controls**: Located on the right side of the terminal panel, including:
    - Bash icon.
    - Plus icon for new terminal.
    - Split icon.
    - Close icon.
    - More options icon (three dots).
    - Up arrow icon.
    - Close icon (X).

## Status Bar

- **Status Bar Items**:
  - **Problems, Output, Debug Console, Terminal, Ports**: Indicators for each tab.
  - **Show welcome page on startup**: A checkbox with a checkmark, indicating it is enabled.
  - **User Profile Icon**: A person silhouette icon.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon with a notification badge (number 1).
  - **Outline and Timeline Icons**: Located below the gear icon, with expandable sections labeled "OUTLINE" and "TIMELINE".

## System Tray and Desktop Icons

- **System Tray**: Located at the top right of the screen, showing icons for:
  - Network
  - Sound
  - Power
- **Desktop Icons**: Located on the left side of the screen, including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

## Additional UI Elements

- **Search Box**: A search box is visible in the main editor area, with the text "er/project/" entered.
- **Search Suggestions**: Below the search box, three suggestions are displayed:
  - "Grunt task detection is turned off. Enable grunt task detection..."
  - "Gulp
